entries.title: Hosea 6:1
segments: ¶Come, and let us return unto the LORD: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.

words.text: , and he will bind us up

entries.title: Hosea 6:2
segments: After two days will he revive us: in the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live in his sight.

entries.title: Hosea 6:3
segments: Then shall we know, [if] we follow on to know the LORD: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter [and] former rain unto the earth.

entries.title: Hosea 6:4
segments: ¶O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? for your goodness [is] as a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goeth away. {goodness: or, mercy, or, kindness}

entries.title: Hosea 6:5
segments: Therefore have I hewed [them] by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and thy judgments [are as] the light [that] goeth forth. {and...: or, that thy judgments might be, etc}

words.text: . {and...: or, that thy judgments might be, etc}

entries.title: Hosea 6:6
segments: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.

entries.title: Hosea 6:7
segments: But they like men have transgressed the covenant: there have they dealt treacherously against me. {men: or, Adam}

entries.title: Hosea 6:8
segments: Gilead [is] a city of them that work iniquity, [and is] polluted with blood. {polluted: or, cunning for}

entries.title: Hosea 6:9
segments: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, [so] the company of priests murder in the way by consent: for they commit lewdness. {by...: Heb. with one shoulder, or, to Shechem} {lewdness: or, enormity}

words.text: . {by...: Heb. with one shoulder, or, to Shechem} {lewdness: or, enormity}

entries.title: Hosea 6:10
segments: I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Israel: there [is] the whoredom of Ephraim, Israel is defiled.

entries.title: Hosea 6:11
segments: Also, O Judah, he hath set an harvest for thee, when I returned the captivity of my people.
